rationale: Identity: in the held 2 FR 3097 page, the text immediately before '[No. 7759]' is the order 'Revoking Executive Orders Nos. 7024-B and 7129-A', approved December 1, 1937. Its single operative sentence revokes and supersedes those two orders by EO 7757 and EO 7758. The revocation is self-executing, complete on approval, and carries no continuing command, date or condition; the own-text record re-derives from the frozen original. The catalog observation names no instrument acting on 7759. Provisional no rests on the order's own terms and is supported.
